description: Prepare a video as MP4 (H.264 + AAC, plays everywhere), MP3, or a looping GIF of up to 10 s, and return a download link. The link works for 15 minutes after the last request. Long videos may still be preparing when this returns: then call check_download with the job_id. Counts against the caller's daily limit (40 per IP).

end.description: Optional: end of the part to keep, in seconds (after start).

item.description: Which video of a multi-video post (1-based); see get_video_info.

quality.description: Resolution cap (the smaller side, so vertical videos count the same). "audio" gives an MP3; "gif" a looping GIF of a selection up to 10 s (set start and end).

start.description: Optional: start of the part to keep, in seconds.

url.description: Link to a public post or video (YouTube, Instagram, X / Twitter, TikTok, Bluesky, Facebook, VK, LinkedIn, Weibo, Twitch, Kick).

name: download_video
title: Download video
